findings.message: model restricts column "status" of table "posts" to the values ("draft", "published"), but the database does not enforce that: the column is neither a native enum nor covered by a CHECK listing values
findings.fix: Restrict column "status" of table "posts" to the values ("draft", "published"): keep the enum in the model, then regenerate the migration so the column becomes a native enum or gets a CHECK listing exactly these values, and apply it.
